notes.title: Gettysburg: The Tide Turns v1.05
notes.notes:
Hi all, we are releasing a new patch: Gettysburg: The Tide Turns is being upgraded to version 1.05. It is a minor one, consisting of some tweaks and fixes.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Fixed USA AI freeze when no more objs to defend
- Fixed MP crash where a enemy unit would sometimes spawn out of the map and freeze the game
- Fixed MP bug where victory checks would show wrong info

notes.title: Version 1.04 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Gettysburg: The Tide Turns has been updated to version 1.04! We have fixed some recurring bugs and changed the game saves folder.

Check out the full changelog below!

[U]Changelog:[/U]

- Singleplayer Campaign game can now be continued even if an early victory is achieved
- Fixed victory screen sometimes showing the wrong outcome
- Fixed Tournament scoring
- Fixed AI crash where it didn't have any available rally moves
- Fixed MP freeze where two units would overlap
- Changed save folder to c:\Users\<user name>\Documents\My Games\Gettysburg TTT\ (game will copy the old saves on the first run)
- Fixed Calendar not reporting entry hexes correctly

notes.title: Gettysburg: The Tide Turns is out!
notes.notes:
The Battle of Gettysburg, fought between the Army of the Potomac and the Army of Northern Virginia, is considered by many the turning point of the American Civil War.

Lasted three days, from July 1st to July 3rd, 1863, the battle saw many epic and tragic moments, culminating in the famous Pickett's Charge, the desperate frontal assault of the confederates against the unionist defensive lines at Cemetery Ridge.

Today, Shenandoah and Slitherine are very proud to release [b]Gettysburg: The Tide Turns[/b], the brilliant hex-based wargame that will make you relive all the hard tactical choices the Confederates and the Unionists had to take during these long and crucial days of fierce fighting.

[b]But the news is not over![/b] We have just opened the gates for the first [b][u]Gettysburg: The Tide Turns Tournament![/u][/b]

Take the challenge and defy your human opponents! The tournament will start on Wednesday 19th! Click [url=http://slitherine.com/tournaments/tournaments.asp]here[/url]to sign up!

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]! Only 8 players will be allowed initially, so first come first served! We will add more players in future matches once we will collect enough feedback! Even if we did beta testing during the development stage, “no plan resists contact with the enemy”!

[b]What are you waiting? Grab Gettysburg: The Tide Turns now![/b]
